cases.title: Sidebar menu for OWNER: role-specific items visible/hidden, role badge, groups accordion
Sidebar menu for ADMIN: role-specific items visible/hidden, role badge, groups accordion
Sidebar menu for MANAGER: role-specific items visible/hidden, role badge, groups accordion
Sidebar menu for AGENT: role-specific items visible/hidden, role badge, groups accordion
Sidebar group header toggles collapse/expand (aria-expanded)
Every visible sidebar link navigates and its page renders cleanly (OWNER)
Every visible sidebar link navigates and its page renders cleanly (ADMIN)
Every visible sidebar link navigates and its page renders cleanly (MANAGER)
Every visible sidebar link navigates and its page renders cleanly (AGENT)
AGENT opening restricted URLs is redirected to Home (no flash of forbidden data)
MANAGER opening restricted URLs is redirected to Home (no flash of forbidden data)
OWNER opening /vector/admin/... is redirected to Home
AGENT opening /vector/admin/... is redirected to Home
Server also refuses AGENT on team/inbox/campaign management endpoints (403), not just the UI
Unknown routes (/app/does-not-exist, /vector/xyz, /app/campaigns/<bad id>) end on a safe page, no crash
Help button opens panel for the current screen; Close button and Esc close it
? and F1 keyboard shortcuts toggle help; ? is ignored while typing in a field
Help panel search finds articles, opens one, Back returns; "Open in Help Center" deep-links
Context help: every routed article opens for its own screen (panel title == article title)
Help Center: every article id deep link /app/help/<id> resolves to its own article and renders cleanly
Help Center: unknown article falls back gracefully; search + topic navigation + related links + "Go to this screen" work
Ctrl+K focuses global search; typing 1 char shows nothing, 2+ shows matching contact
Clicking a result opens that contact; query cleared
No-match query shows "No matches"; Enter goes to contacts?q=; Escape closes
Search API failure degrades silently (no crash, no [object Object])
Tenant isolation: another workspace cannot find this contact via search
Bell shows unread count, lists notifications, unread highlighted; empty state for other user
Clicking a notification marks it read (DB), closes the list and follows its link
Mark all read clears the badge and reads everything in DB
Email-copy checkbox persists the preference
Profile menu shows name, email, role; entries: Change password, Account security, Calendar sync, Sign out
Change password modal: opens/closes (X, backdrop); validation: min length, mismatch
Wrong current password shows server error and does not change the password
Correct change: success state, modal auto-closes, new password logs in, old one fails; user stays signed in
Forgot-password link inside the modal requests a reset (token row created) and confirms
Sign out: back on /login, stored user cleared, API session invalid; browser Back does not reopen app
A page whose API returns 500 shows an error state instead of crashing the shell (Campaigns list)
Narrow viewport (390px) login + dashboard do not crash
